Four law enforcement officers were lost during a shooting in Charlotte, North Carolina. Praying for their families at this difficult time and for the other officers still receiving medical treatment. 
A sobering reminder of the risks & sacrifices our law enforcement make to keep us safe everyday.

Honored to meet with Emersyn, a young Nebraskan, who is thriving one year after treatment! Her story is a testament to the lifesaving work of our children’s hospitals. Thank you to Nebraska Children’s Hospital for the work you do to provide extraordinary care to our youth. https://t.co/zqCctEkcZm
Today is Election Day! Nebraskans, get out & exercise your right to vote!

Met with @ChildrensNE President & CEO, Chanda Chacón. We discussed the exciting progress of the new Behavioral Health and Wellness Center. The health and well-being of our kids should always be a top priority! https://t.co/xpiBRGQwPc

Meat will Make America Healthy Again. And no better meat than Nebraska beef!

Nebraska beef is quality, delicious and tender.
https://t.co/PH7bLXQJvg

President Trump is delivering on his campaign promises to level the playing field and stand up for the American people. 

Reciprocal tariffs will ensure equal treatment for American businesses. 

@POTUS is working to reshore jobs lost overseas and secure our supply chains. 

He is working to open new markets for our nation’s agriculture products. 

He is demonstrating to foreign adversaries like China that we will no longer be taken advantage of.

I appreciate the Nebraska Hospital Association for hosting a federal delegation roundtable this week. I heard about the issues Nebraska hospitals are facing. I thanked them for ensuring that Nebraskans across the state receive excellent healthcare. https://t.co/akRrKpJW3S

As Governor and now as your Senator, clean and reliable water for Nebraska has always been a top priority of mine.

That’s why I toured the Regional Wastewater Treatment Plant in South Sioux City, NE this week. They’re working to expand their operation to serve both residential users and businesses. This will help South Sioux City increase economic development and create jobs.

The One Big Beautiful Bill Act delivers for rural hospitals and health care providers. It provides $50 billion to rural hospitals over the next five years.

Nebraska specifically will see a minimum of $100 million a year in support to rural hospitals.

This important legislation supports Nebraskans and Americans living in rural areas by supporting their hospitals and health care facilities.

The One Big Beautiful Bill Act provides $50 billion for rural hospitals and health care providers the next 5 years.
  
Nebraska will see a minimum of $100 million a year in support to rural hospitals from this bill.

Get the facts: https://t.co/KnFvdXxO0a

Met with Nebraskans from the American Physical Therapy Association to discuss Medicare payment reform, access to physical therapy, and burdensome regulations for PT clinics. As part of the OBBB, we passed an increase in Medicare payments made to medical providers for 2026. https://t.co/BnPCL8TlHu

This week, the Senate passed a rescissions package to re-focus our federal spending on things that matter to Americans--not foreign nationals. 
 
$2.5 million in tax dollars should never have been spent teaching children how to make “environmentally friendly reproductive health decisions.”
 
This bill restores common-sense to federal spending.

In the past, the federal government spent $4 million of YOUR tax dollars for “sedentary migrants” in Colombia, $3 million for sexual reproductive health in Venezuela, and $1 million for voter ID in Haiti.
 
That is a waste of Americans’ hard earned tax dollars. The rescissions package passed by the Senate this week restores common-sense to American aid.

Our veterans deserve our utmost respect and gratitude. In order to ensure our veterans receive the best standard of care, it is important that their medical history is shared and available for VA medical centers following care in the community. This bill will help establish guidelines and procedures for VA medical facilities to obtain medical documentation from community care providers.

The OBBB puts rural patients front and center. It guarantees a minimum of $100 million for a Rural Healthcare Fund to be distributed to rural Nebraska hospitals over the next five years.

Get the facts: https://t.co/KnFvdXxO0a

The OBBB makes every Medicaid dollar work smarter for Nebraskans who need it most. Some of the media and the left has been pushing false Democrat talking points about this generational bill.

Medicaid is going to continue to grow by $750 billion over the next ten years. This will make sure that it is still serving those who need it most: kids, elderly, and the disabled.

Liberal states have been draining your tax dollars to give healthcare to illegal immigrants. The One Big Beautiful Bill gets Medicaid back on track. It preserves Medicaid for Americans who need it most.

@SenateGOP is delivering on your priorities.

The One Big Beautiful Bill gets Medicaid back on track. In the past, Medicaid dollars have gone to dead people or people registered in two states. But that ended with the One Big Beautiful Bill. Medicaid dollars are now going to those who need them the most.

The best part of my job as U.S. Senator is that I get to work for Nebraskans. Through the passage of the OBBB, we are avoiding a $2,443 tax hike on Nebraskans. We are helping seniors keep more of their Social Security benefits.  We’re improving healthcare and veterans’ services. I’m proud of the work my team and I have done fighting for Nebraska this year.

I’m committed to ensuring veterans across the state have access to quality healthcare. That’s why I introduced the CARING for Our Veterans Health Act. This bill will make it easier for VA Care Providers to access patient medical records from non-VA hospitals. That will help veterans get the proper care they deserve!

The OBBB supports rural health in Nebraska, investing in outcomes now and for future generations. Starting this week, states can apply for the Rural Health Transformation (RHT) program to receive part of the $50B allocated for rural health care in the OBBB. That’s 50% more through Medicaid for rural healthcare.

Nebraska partners can visit the following website to learn more: https://t.co/7ouSb4Z01g

Chuck Schumer is threatening to hold the federal government hostage over temporary COVID-era healthcare subsidies.  
  
Without releasing a plan or engaging in bipartisan talks, Democrats like @SenSchumer are threatening a shutdown if these subsidies are not added to our government funding bill. That is wrong! 
  
Republicans are working to responsibly fund the government.

Great to meet with Hy-Vee's CEO Jeremy Gosch and other Hy-Vee teammates. We discussed Hy-Vee's role in increasing access to healthy foods. This initiative will help deliver personalized health and wellness benefits to Medicaid, Medicare and other health insurance beneficiaries.

Hy-Vee is also a champion for biofuels. Last time I filled up at Hy-Vee, I saved 45 cents a gallon on E10. Thanks for coming by!

Supporting the Good Life for all Nebraskans is my top priority as Senator. One of the most important ways we can do this is by supporting rural healthcare.
 
@SenateGOP and @POTUS did just this by passing the OBBB into law. The OBBB created a $50 billion Rural Health Fund. This will support dependable care for Nebraskans in rural areas!

Chuck Schumer is recklessly threatening to shut down the government. He wants Nebraska taxpayers to foot the bill for his partisan projects.  @SenateGOP wants to pass a clean funding bill. @SenateDems want to repeal a $50 billion investment in rural healthcare. That harms Nebraska. This is not how government is supposed to work.
